mapper.select: SELECT ua.id,ua.username,ua.display_name,ua.enabled,ua.last_login_at,s.staff_no,s.staff_type, GROUP_CONCAT(r.code ORDER BY r.code) role_codes FROM user_account ua LEFT JOIN staff s ON s.id=ua.staff_id LEFT JOIN user_role ur ON ur.user_id=ua.id LEFT JOIN role r ON r.id=ur.role_id GROUP BY ua.id,ua.username,ua.display_name,ua.enabled,ua.last_login_at,s.staff_no,s.staff_type ORDER BY ua.id

SELECT r.id,r.code,r.name,r.active,GROUP_CONCAT(p.code ORDER BY p.code) permissions FROM role r LEFT JOIN role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.id LEFT JOIN permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id GROUP BY r.id,r.code,r.name,r.active ORDER BY r.id
SELECT id,code,name FROM permission ORDER BY code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_role(user_id,role_id) SELECT #{userId},id FROM role WHERE code=#{roleCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_account SET enabled=#{enabled} WHERE id=#{userId}
